parsed.explanation: No trans criminalisation, no documented border friction, facility ban or police targeting of visitors; anti-discrimination law covers gender identity, and courts convicted an attacker in 2023 using bias aggravating grounds — functioning recourse for assault. But the worst documented feature is tier-3 societal hostility with thin remedy: hate speech remained serious in 2023 with no meaningful government response, the prosecutor was ineffective, a mayor hostile to LGBTI groups, and a Pride crowd made kill threats (police did arrest). The 2002 attitudinal survey is stale and LGB-focused, so it carries little current weight. LGR failure is resident-facing and undocumented as reaching visitors — an open question, not an exposure. No universal-exposure measure or trans-specific violence rate is documented. Hostility with partial, working-for-victims recourse sits in Elevated Risk, below the acceptance tiers and above documented service-discrimination cases.
